title: 'The Open Doors': von Neumann's fear at his death

tellings.quote: And I wrote a short story about this about Bon Norman's death called the open doors

plain: The mathematician John von Neumann is said to have died in 1957 gripped by fear over something he had come to understand, a story tied to the idea that some lines of physics were deliberately steered into dead ends. The writer Whitley Strieber brings it up without naming a source, and says he turned von Neumann's death into a short story of his own called The Open Doors.
